The GPU energy-distance pipeline the IGVF TF Perturb-seq consortium runs (step 0 PCA + guide dictionary; step 1 outlier guides via DISCO, hypergeometric ranking and K-means on non-targeting guides; step 2 per-target energy distance vs num_bg random non-targeting backgrounds with permutation p-values -> pval_edist_full.csv). IGVFagent's tf-perturb edist-prep / edist-filter / edist re-derive the statistics on CPU with numpy/scipy (E = 2*mean cross - within - within; pval_mean_log = -log10(pval_mean + 0.1/(perm*bg))) and write the same column schema, defaults num_bg 20, permutations 1000, non_target_pick 2000, target max 2000. For 10^5-cell screens run the upstream container and hand its folder to edist-validate / edist-summary.

CLEANSER 1.2.1 (Gersbachlab-Bioinformatics/CLEANSER @ d28c31b5, MIT) cs/dc Stan models were re-derived: same likelihoods, truncation, priors, bounds, lpf=2 normalisation and median-PZi output, but sampled with adaptive Metropolis on Stan's unconstrained scale instead of NUTS, so posteriors match only up to Monte-Carlo error. The GSE272457 data are not downloaded. Sampler-warning counts come from the log only when the real CLEANSER binary is used.

Ported every exported R function (convert_mudata_to_sceptre_object, assign_grnas_sceptre, inference_sceptre, sceptre_object_to_mudata, sceptre_object_to_mudata_inputs_outputs, save_mudata_list) and the testthat assertions. The sceptre R package's statistics are re-implemented in Python as a documented approximation: NB GLM score test, CRT or permutation null, a method-of-moments skew-normal fit with a KS check, and a reduced-EM Poisson mixture. p-values are calibrated and of the same magnitude, but they do not match sceptre digit for digit.
